values.label: Delete
values.description: Delete when the governing operation/policy authorizes deletion.

values.label: Anonymize
values.description: Remove identifying linkage using the approved anonymization process.

values.label: Retain Per Policy
values.description: Retain according to the owning retention class/policy.

values.label: Protected Retention
values.description: Do not delete automatically because integrity/security/financial evidence may require retention.

values.label: Review Required
values.description: A human/policy decision is required before deletion or anonymization.
